title: Fixed servicing-camera coverage of the flush fiducial workflow envelope
single_physical_change: the flush datum becomes a pair, separated by more than the destination lead-in shadow; placement, lens, resolution, marker size, quiet zone and estimator gates are unchanged

coverage.criterion: the estimator reads whichever plate it can decode, so one usable plate covers a pose

projection.marker_cell_requirement_derivation: four interior samples plus a two-pixel rendered edge transition on each side
projection.measured_over: the usable plate at each sampled pose

scope_and_limitations: Projection proves coverage and front-face incidence, not rendered detection.
The static rendered corpus holds the robot still; continuous occlusion is exercised only by the strict RGB-D chain.
Rack parts are not occluders here; scripts/check_rack_sightlines.py owns that question.
Rear-gripper clearance uses its recorded collision envelope co-rotated with the captured module.
Lens, aperture, resolution and estimator gates are unchanged; the datum layout is the current one-change arm.
